question: Who are the professors in the Computer Science department?
sql: SELECT name, title FROM faculty WHERE department = 'Computer Science';

question: Show me the email address for a professor named Dr. Ada Lovelace
sql: SELECT email FROM faculty WHERE name = 'Dr. Ada Lovelace';

question: How many faculty members were hired after January 1, 2020?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty WHERE hire_date > '2020-01-01';

question: List all publications from the year 2021
sql: SELECT title, journal_name FROM publications WHERE publication_year = 2021;

question: Which papers are the most cited?
sql: SELECT title, citation_count FROM publications ORDER BY citation_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show me all papers published by the professor with ID 3
sql: SELECT p.title, p.publication_year FROM publications p JOIN faculty f ON p.author_id = f.faculty_id WHERE f.faculty_id = 3;

question: How many publications does each department have?
sql: SELECT f.department, COUNT(p.publication_id) AS number_of_publications FROM faculty f JOIN publications p ON f.faculty_id = p.author_id GROUP BY f.department ORDER BY number_of_publications DESC;
